label: alpha-galactosidase activity
definition: A phenotype in which a microorganism produces active alpha-galactosidase enzymes that hydrolyze alpha-1,6-linked galactose residues in oligosaccharides and polymeric galactomannans.
observations: Follow-up from the physiology diagnostic-enzyme gap sweep; absent from METPO and TraitMech after an alpha-galactosidase duplicate review covering ignored and hidden files.
